title: 第7章 诬陷第8章 被刘刚看重
slug: 开局黑狼拳简化后让我学狼叫
content_zh:
“是！”
两名精锐帮众冷冷一笑，拿起皮鞭就狠狠抽。
“啪……”
“啊……”
阿顺这辈子没怎么吃过肉，两人几鞭子下去，就给他炒了盘皮鞭炒肉，让他吃个饱。
“我，我招，我知道奸细……”
十鞭子下去，阿顺撑不住被屈打成招。
刘刚挥手制止：“停，你说奸细是谁？”
“是厨子王大伟，还有副厨子，还有……以及新来的墩子赵寒。”
阿顺随便乱供，把整个厨房的几人都给供了出来。
反正自己也要死，死也要拉上一些人垫背。
其他帮众他不熟悉，但厨房的个个都认识，其中还有坑过自己的墩子，都给我陪葬吧。
他对厨房大部分人都相当痛恨。
“呵呵，你当我是傻子啊！”刘刚冷冷一笑，“你说他们都是奸细，要是做饭放毒，怕是堂主和我早就被他们下药毒死了，还能活到今天？”
“看来你还没老实招供啊，你俩出去，我单独给他长长见识。”刘刚对两人挥了挥手道。
“是！”
等两人离开后，刘刚便抽了阿顺几鞭子。
“啊……”
“杀了我吧……”
剧痛之下，阿顺差点晕厥。

几鞭子下去，刘刚收手，接着在阿顺耳旁低声附语：“软骨头一个，你要是不想死的这么难看，我可以给你个机会。”
“头，头目，什，什么机会？”阿顺意识模糊道。
“奸细明明是王豹，也是王豹给你的黑狼拳秘籍。”
刘刚笑眯眯道。
王豹是另外一个头目王虎的亲弟弟，武功不在他之下，仅次于王虎。
王虎经常和自己作对，在堂主面前争宠，两人明里暗里较量了多次，刘刚都是略逊一筹。
借着这个好机会，刘刚想要除掉王豹，断掉王虎的一条臂膀。
至于为何不直接指认王虎，刘刚知道没用。
堂主深知两人相互斗来斗去，你坑我我阴你，这种单方面的指认必然不会相信。
但王豹就不同了，他地位没有王虎高，只要死死咬定，必然能中伤他。
“王豹？是王头目的亲弟弟？”阿顺脸色一变，得罪了王虎，自己怕是死的更惨。
content_en:
"Yes!"
The two elite gang members smiled coldly, picked up the whips and whipped them hard.
"Pa..."
"Ah..."
Ah Shun had never eaten meat in his life, so the two of them gave him a plate of stir-fried meat with whips, so that he could eat enough.
"I, I recruit, I know spies..."
After ten lashes, Ah Shun couldn't hold on and was beaten into a move.
Liu Gang waved his hand to stop him: "Stop, who do you think the spy is?"
"It's the cook Wang Dawei, the sous chef, and... and the new guy Zhao Han."
Ah Shun confessed casually and confessed to everyone in the kitchen.
He was going to die anyway, and he had to drag some people along to support him.
He is not familiar with the other members of the gang, but he knows everyone in the kitchen, including some who have cheated him. Let me bury them all.
He hated most of the people in the kitchen.
"Haha, you think I'm a fool!" Liu Gang smiled coldly, "You said they are all spies. If they poisoned the food, the hall master and I would have been poisoned by them long ago. Are we still alive today?"
"It seems that you haven't confessed honestly yet. You two go out and I will give him a long experience alone." Liu Gang waved to the two of them.
"Yes!"
After the two left, Liu Gang whipped Ah Shun several times.
"Ah..."
"Kill me..."
Under the severe pain, Ah Shun almost fainted.
After a few whips, Liu Gang stopped his hand and whispered in Ah Shun's ear: "You're a weakling. If you don't want to die so ugly, I can give you a chance."
"Head, boss, what, what chance?" Ah Shun said in confusion.
"The spy is obviously Wang Bao, and it was Wang Bao who gave you the secret book of Black Wolf Fist."
Liu Gang said with a smile.
Wang Bao is the younger brother of another leader, Wang Hu. His martial arts skills are not inferior to him, second only to Wang Hu.
Wang Hu often opposed himself and competed for favor in front of the hall master. The two competed many times overtly and covertly, and Liu Gang was always slightly inferior.
Taking advantage of this good opportunity, Liu Gang wanted to get rid of Wang Bao and break off one of Wang Hu's arms.
As for why he didn't identify Wang Hu directly, Liu Gang knew it was useless.
The hall master knew that the two of them were fighting each other, you were cheating on me and I was cheating on you, so he would definitely not believe this unilateral identification.
But Wang Bao is different. His status is not as high as Wang Hu. As long as he insists on it, he will definitely be slandered.
"Wang Bao? Is he the brother of the king?" Ah Shun's expression changed. He offended Wang Hu and was afraid that he would die even worse.
